tutorial.promptDesc: New to Kita? Play a quick interactive tutorial to learn the core rules, or skip straight into the game!
tutorial.interactiveHint: Tap a piece to select it, then tap a highlighted tile to move.
tutorial.lesson1Step1Card1: This is the Kita board shape.
tutorial.lesson1Step1Card2: Each side has 1 King ♔ and 2 Pawns. You are positioned at bottom-right.
tutorial.lesson1Step2Desc: Each tile has a value: 1, 2, or 3. Notice the numbers and color shades on each tile. These numbers determine how pieces move!
tutorial.lesson1Step3Card1: Your goal is to capture the opponent's king or leave them with no moves.
tutorial.lesson1Step3Card2: Kings can be captured, pawns cannot.
tutorial.lesson2Step1Desc: The step count each turn equals the value of the tile the opponent's King stands on.
tutorial.lesson2Step2Desc: You cannot pass through other pieces. Make a move yourself. Tap any piece to select it and move.
tutorial.lesson2Step2Success: Great move! You made a legal move using dynamic step count.
tutorial.lesson2Step3Desc: You cannot undo your previous move by moving the same piece back to where it just came from. Try to move the same piece.
tutorial.lesson2Step3SubPrompt: Now try to move your piece. Notice that reversing back to where it just came from is blocked!
tutorial.lesson2Step3Success: Notice how the piece cannot return to where it just came from! You successfully completed your second turn.
tutorial.lesson2Step4Desc: However, if that reversal is ONLY legal move on the board, it is allowed.
tutorial.lesson3Step1Desc: You <mint>win</mint> if you capture opponent's king.
tutorial.lesson3Step1Success: Checkmate! You captured the King directly.
tutorial.lesson3Step2Desc: If your opponent has no legal moves when their turn arrives, you <mint>win</mint>! Make one move to trap the opponent and win.
tutorial.lesson3Step2Success: Victory! Opponent has no legal moves and is trapped.
tutorial.lesson3Step3Desc: When a king is captured, the opponent gets one final retaliation turn. This retaliation move triggers automatically if exists. If the opponent can capture your king in return, the game ends in a DRAW.
tutorial.lesson3Step3Success: Retaliation executed! Both kings have fallen. The game ends in a DRAW.
tutorial.lesson3Step4Desc: A draw also occurs if the exact same board position is repeated 3 times (Threefold Repetition), or if both players mutually agree to a draw.
